items.text: haan ji
kal tak
nahi aaya

items.context: Can you please confirm if you received the OTP?
items.text: thik hai

items.context: Have you tried logging in after waiting for a few minutes?
items.text: nahi abhi

items.context: Do you want me to resend the OTP now?
items.text: theek hai
mera mobile bank khul nahi raha hai otp nahi aa raha
haan ji thoda rukna OTP nahi aa raha hai
main try karta hua fir keh raha hoon karna hai login
mera number update nahi hua toh otp nahi mil raha hai
Tuesday nahi Wednesday ko transfer kiya tha paisa
accha woh OTP mujhe nahi mila ab kya karu
jab main login karta hoon toh batata hai otp galat hai

items.context: Do you know if you have registered the correct mobile number?
items.text: haan otp milega par form fill karna hoga

items.context: Have you checked your mobile network or message inbox?
items.text: nahin otp nahi aaya phir kya karna hai

items.context: Can you please tell me the last four digits of your mobile number?
items.text: ha usi number pe sab set hai par fir bhi nahi aaya

items.context: Are you trying to login through mobile app or internet banking website?
items.text: mujhe thoda samajh nahi aa raha yeh problem ke wajah kya hai

items.context: Is your mobile phone connected to internet while trying to login?
items.text: woh matlab internet banking app pe try kar raha hoon lekin
bas OTP aa nahi raha kabhi kabhi delay hota hai ya phir bilkul nahi aata mera phone theek chal raha hai
mera account se paise cut gaye lekin login karne ke liye jo OTP aata hai woh mujhe nahi mil raha
ma'am mera mobile number updated hai par phir bhi jab login karta hoon toh OTP receive nahi hota hai mujhe

items.context: Can you describe your network connection and whether OTP is delayed or not received at all?
items.text: main aapko batadu ki mera mobile ekdum strong network mein hai lekin fir bhi OTP receive nahi ho raha hai

items.context: Have you observed similar issues with OTP on any other apps or services?
items.text: mujhe aisa lagta hai ki system me kuch dikkat hai kyunki mera phone bilkul sahi hai aur dusre log OTP le rahe hain

items.context: Can you share when was the last time you successfully received OTP and logged in without problem?
items.text: jis time maine last withdrawal kiya tha usse pehle tak sab login sahi thu lekin ab jab OTP bhejte hai toh nahi aata

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: login_otp_problem - cannot log in to net or mobile banking or is not receiving the OTP
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
